name: Juicebox
summary: AI recruiting platform that searches 800M+ profiles, verifies candidates and runs outreach.
description: Juicebox searches more than 800 million profiles from over 30 sources using natural-language queries, verifies candidates and sends email outreach, with recruiting agents that learn how the user searches. The Free plan includes limited searches; Starter costs $119 per seat per month, with yearly billing at a 15% discount. It supports agents that run searches automatically. It also provides AI email templates and a Juicebox Agent setup on the free plan.

howToUse.title: Open Juicebox
howToUse.description: Open Juicebox and choose Try for free, or book a demo.

howToUse.title: Search profiles in natural language
howToUse.description: Type a natural-language query. The search covers more than 800 million profiles drawn from over 30 sources.

howToUse.title: Verify candidates and email them
howToUse.description: Verify the candidates you want, then send email outreach. Recruiting agents learn how you search, and AI email templates are provided.

howToUse.title: Let an agent search, then pick a plan
howToUse.description: Let agents run searches automatically. The Free plan includes limited searches and a Juicebox Agent setup. On Starter, each seat is $119 a month, and yearly billing takes 15% off.

features_fr: Plateforme de recrutement IA qui recherche plus de 800 millions de profils, vérifie les candidats et mène des actions de sensibilisation.

Juicebox recherche plus de 800 millions de profils provenant de plus de 30 sources à l'aide de requêtes en langage naturel, vérifie les candidats et envoie des courriers électroniques, avec des agents de recrutement qui apprennent comment l'utilisateur recherche.
Le forfait gratuit comprend des recherches limitées ; Starter coûte 119 $ par siège et par mois, avec une facturation annuelle avec une réduction de 15 %.
Il prend en charge les agents qui exécutent automatiquement des recherches.
